title: Lifecycle Specification Schema
description: Schema for lifecycle definitions that define state machines for object kinds

object_type.description: The object kind this lifecycle defines states for (e.g., 'backlog_item', 'goal')

status_mapping.description: Mapping from legacy status values to new status values

statuses.description: List of valid statuses for this object type

transitions.description: List of valid transitions between statuses

origin.description: Whether this is the origin (starting) status

terminal.description: Whether this is a terminal (ending) status

work_done.description: Whether entering this status means a work interval finished (completable completed_at). Not archive. Tokens differ by kind (complete, resolved, implemented, completed).

satisfied.description: Whether this status means a satisfiable predicate holds (criteria validated/complete). Not a work clock.

system.description: Whether this is a system-only/error status

preliminary.description: Whether this is a preliminary/draft status (not shovel-ready)

role.description: Cross-kind semantic role for membership, lock, and ranking (TRACK: BLI-CEF-R26-POLICY-PRI-EXAM-001). shovel_ready = ready to execute; execution_locked = in flight / scope locked; enforced = membrane live (policy/role active, not Gantt); realign = not ready for execution-facing scope; halted = in-place repair without scope-creep ambiguity; terminal = done/archived; grooming = plan/backlog reshaping.

preconditions.description: Preconditions that must be met for this status

shockwave.description: Membrane hop policy when entering this status (inherited via extends unless overridden)

mode.description: cluster = peer story graph, stop at lineage trunks. prune = cascade reverse dependents (branch cut). shared = seed (+ exclusive_kinds) only; fan-in lanes/views. none = this object only (explicit; empty park defaults to cluster).

fail.description: closed = blocked hop freezes the whole tree. open = skip members that cannot hop (not used for archive).

lineage_kinds.description: Trunk kinds that cluster hops stop at (child→parent). Prune does not follow refs to these kinds except the seed.

cluster_kinds.description: Story kinds that cluster together (criteria, backlog_item, requirement).

cluster_ref_fields.description: Reference fields that form the story cluster / downward prune edges.

lineage_ref_fields.description: Child→parent pointer fields. Cluster hops stop here; prune does not walk them (would cut the trunk).

exclusive_kinds.description: Shared-mode only: edge kinds that may archive with the seed (e.g. workstream_transition). Sibling plans/views do not.

manual.description: Whether this transition can be triggered manually

auto.description: Whether this transition can be triggered automatically

preconditions.description: Qualifying exam before the hop (must be true to enter the transition)

postconditions.description: Hold-after-hop claims that must be true once the object occupies the destination (declarative until an evaluator exists). See docs/architecture/LIFECYCLE_STATE_MACHINE_RUBRIC.md

on_dependent_status.description: Auto shockwave trigger: fire when a dependent object of kind reaches status to

to.description: Dependent status (or list of statuses) that triggers this transition

side_effects.description: Field side effects applied when the transition fires (e.g. clear active_order)

clear.description: Object field to clear (set null) when the transition applies

shockwave.description: Override membrane hop policy for this edge (merged onto the destination status policy)
